summary: Module 04 (en) technical review done. I recomputed by independent scripts (tools/labpy.sh) every derivation, worked example, check and answer in s1-s13, every exercise solution and every quiz answer and explanation: the parameter counts (2,080/32,032/1,088/1,120; 26,021; 4,480, 12,961, 3,360, 141,312; e5's 4,672/18,944/14,208/102,912; quiz 2,560/2,480/1,920/640; e15's 10,593 and its multiply-add counts), the memory figures (3.28 GB, 6.55 MB, 32,768 B, 196,608 B per token, 6.44 GB = 6.0 GiB, 0.81 GB), the hand BPTT (g = -0.3099, -0.1345, -0.02824; dL/dw = -0.2151, confirmed by central differences), the w^n table, lags, 2x2 eigen-example, non-normal norms, clipping angles, half-life tables, LSTM step, leaky integrator, MASE, Gaussian false-alarm rates, precision, beam-search toy, additive and dot attention, TCN reach, linear-recurrence/convolution identity, FFT counts, complex mode, LRU half-lives, ZOH values. I also re-simulated the s4 tanh gradient experiment (four draws per setting agree in order of magnitude) and approximately reproduced the s8 sinusoid-plus-drift worked example (global z-score LSTM 0.77-0.96 against naive 0.158, linear 0.103, fixed model 0.12-0.13; same failure, consistent with the text's labelled prepared run). The concept parts have no output fences; their display-only code was run and is correct (rnn_forward matches nn.RNN to 6e-8; set_forget_bias gives exactly 1; the packed-sequence gather equals h_n[-1], and h_n[-2]/h_n[-1] are the right bidirectional states). All 10 exercise code blocks were run: 9 reproduce their output fences exactly; e15 reproduces every RMSE and parameter count for seed 0 and the quoted seed-1 and seed-2 figures (0.132 vs 0.138, 0.134 vs 0.134), and differs only in wall-clock timings, which the text already labels as load-dependent, so the fence was left as is. Every lab number quoted in the concept text, What goes wrong, exercises, quiz and summary matches the labs' printed outputs. Cross-references: all in-page section, lab, exercise and figure references resolve (16 figures, all ids present); bare links to Modules 01-03 and 05-07 point at modules that cover the claimed topics, Modules 08-10 per BRIEF ownership (not yet written); there are no AI Agents links. Citations and years checked; the paper-check corrections for M04 are in place. CANONICAL M04 notes are applied (s13 sampled-moduli wording, e5 at two stars, S1/S3 reading runs split in the plan); the M03 note's e15 reference is correct. Exercise budget 7/7/1, 130 minutes. No public-site violations found (no private-terms file is present locally; checker uses its generic list). Seven fixes were made. node tools/check.mjs --module 4 --lang en --words reports 0 errors, 0 warnings.
